entities.name: Ante Tomić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ante Tomić is a Croatian professional basketball player for Joventut Badalona of the Spanish Liga ACB. He has also represented the senior Croatian national team in international competitions. Standing at 2.18 m, he plays the center position and is a three-time All-EuroLeague Team selection.

entities.summary: Ante Tomić is a Croatian professional basketball player for Joventut Badalona of the Spanish Liga ACB.
